end.summary: Practised place value and expanding base-10 numbers using powers of 10.
end.parentNote: Neel practised expanding 4,075 as 4 × 10³ + 0 × 10² + 7 × 10¹ + 5 × 10⁰, and locating the value of 8 in 7,08,346. They used place names and powers of 10 to work through the examples. A mix-up remained about zero: they treated it as having no role and were unsure why it must be written as a placeholder; this was not corrected by the end. At home, practise a few numbers with zeros by naming every place and writing each digit’s ×10 power, including 0 × its power.
